# MyBridge Loans (mybridge.loans)

> MyBridge Loans is a California-licensed private money / hard money bridge lender and mortgage broker based in Fountain Valley, California. We fund business-purpose bridge loans secured by real estate in 26 states, directly through our own private investors. First and second trust deeds, commercial, and business-purpose loans on owner-occupied homes. We do not fund construction loans. Consumer home loans (conventional, FHA, VA, non-QM) are brokered in California only.

## Key facts
- Legal name: My Bridge Loans Corporation
- Location: Fountain Valley, Orange County, California
- Licenses: California DRE #01716773 · Company NMLS #2869596 · Jevon Perra (broker) NMLS #1006038
- Contact: 949-463-9898 · jevon@mybridge.loans · https://mybridge.loans/#submit
- Loan types: 1st trust deed bridge, 2nd trust deed, commercial bridge, owner-occupied business-purpose hard money
- Not offered: construction / ground-up loans, 2nd trust deeds in Texas
- Typical LTV: up to 75% purchase / 70% refinance on 1st trust deeds in Southern California; up to 65% CLTV on 2nd trust deeds in Southern California; roughly 5% lower outside Southern California
- Pricing: interest-only; priced on lien position, LTV, property, and exit, not on income
- Speed: answer the same day a scenario is received
- Credit: asset-based; low FICO is not an automatic decline when equity and exit are strong
- Funding source: direct private investors (no bank committee); loans can be brokered to other capital when a scenario falls outside our box
- Who we work with: borrowers, real estate investors, mortgage brokers and loan officers (referral partners are protected on every file), attorneys with clients needing estate, divorce, or tax-lien liquidity
- Consumer mortgages (California only): conventional, FHA, VA, non-QM

## States for bridge loans
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Missouri, Montana, New Jersey, New Mexico, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas (no 2nds), Washington, West Virginia

## Common questions we answer
- Hard money 2nd trust deed in Orange County / Los Angeles
- Bridge loan to buy a house before selling the current one in California
- Private money loan on a probate or inherited property
- Cash-out on a free-and-clear rental
- Business-purpose loan on an owner-occupied home
- Paying off an IRS or state tax lien with a real estate loan
- Bailing out a loan in default (non-owner-occupied)
